changes_from_v2: Owner yes 2026-11-20 (ledger L2756, round-1 re-ranker adopted L2751): topic_landing keeps its stage name and every v2 field, and gains the topic re-ranker (reranker.py, runs/pulse/topic_loop/r1/primary_reranker.pkl, specs/rerank_calibration_v1.json). out.l1_code, out.p, out.decision, out.agrees_rollup and the journal ids.topic (best = the best card under the answered level-1 code, l1, l2) now describe the RE-RANKER's answer; the landing's own level-1 code, p and decision move to out.landing_l1_code, out.landing_p, out.landing_decision; best, top3, l1_agree3, vote, voted, n_sent, damped stay the landing's evidence. New out.rerank {l1_code, p, top2 [[code, p] x2], version 'rerank-r1:<model sha16>', node}. The topic_node decider field takes the re-ranker's p and its own line (specs/rerank_calibration_v1.json line_permille). Stage out cap for topic_landing is 1000 characters (others 700). New informational gap RERANK_DISAGREE; LANDING_WEAK now means the re-ranker's decision is ABSTAIN. run.json version live-trace-v3, label_version gains rerank_model and rerank_calibration, degraded gains 'no re-ranker: ...' (ALLOW_NO_RERANK=1 only; without it a card-list or cards_sha mismatch, or a calibration fitted on another model, refuses to start). stages_full.topic_landing gains rerank_features and rerank_calibration. v1 and v2 runs stay valid (verify_trace, funnel_view, the page).
changes_from_v1: Owner-approved 2026-11-19 (ledger L2735). New stage topic_landing (after domain_rollup, before structure_pack); structure_pack drops l1_guess and guess_top3 and gains l1_code_used; run.json gains version, label_version and degraded; gap codes LANDING_SPLIT and LANDING_WEAK added, TOPIC_DISAGREE relabelled reference. v1 traces (no topic_landing stage, run.json without version) stay valid and readable. Step 3 (graph, journal-v0, inside the same yes): every traced line gains a journal object (ids, story keys, dup, publishers); run.json gains journal_version and journal; gap code SYNDICATED; verify_trace checks the journal against the lines before it. Runs without journal_version (step 2) stay valid.
purpose: Contract between the runner (live_trace.py), the aggregator (live_gaps.py), the checker (verify_trace.py) and the page (demo/mockups/structure-live/index.html). Change it only through the owner session; a builder who needs a change reports it and stops.

files.run.json: one object, rewritten atomically every 3 s: the run header plus aggregates and gaps (see run)
files.tail.json: list of the last 40 article lines, newest first (each is the parsed article_line, not the chain wrapper)
files.chain.jsonl: append-only, one chain_line per traced article, in seq order, no gaps
files.a/<seq>.json: raw record for article seq: {article_line, text (the exact string read), stages_full (full stage outputs)}
files.fixture/: same layout (v2) with 6 made-up articles (clean, teaser-only, error stage, not_attached, a syndicated copy of the clean one, a landing abstain) so the page can be built and tested before the runner exists; the page opens it with ?fixture=1. fixture-v1/ keeps the earlier v1 fixture (4 articles) so the page fallback has a test: ?fixture=1&v=1

chain_line.seq: int, 0,1,2,... no gaps; skipped rows also get a line (state skipped, with the reason)
chain_line.prev: hex sha256 of the previous chain_line (seq 0: the run_id)
chain_line.sha: hex sha256 of (prev + line), both as UTF-8 text
chain_line.line: STRING: the article_line as compact JSON (sort_keys, separators , and :, ensure_ascii false). The page verifies by hashing this string as written; it never re-serialises

run.start_epoch: float, recorded on the ledger before the first article
run.ends_epoch: float, start + duration cap (at most 3600 s)
run.code_hash: first 16 hex of sha256 over file_sha values
run.version: live-trace-v3 (live-trace-v2 or absent/live-trace-v1 on older runs)
run.label_version: {iptc_release, cards (first 16 hex of the sha256 over the card strings in qcode order), table (name-to-code table version), calibration (first 16 hex of the sha256 of specs/landing_calibration_v1.json; null when the run used landing-v0)}
run.journal_version: journal-v0 on runs that write the journal (step 3); absent on step 2 runs. verify_trace requires a journal on every traced line when it is present
run.journal: {records, first, copy, republished, generic_title, no_key, independent_items (stories, each counted once), multi_publisher_stories, max_publishers, no_l2_items, l2_nodes: [{code, label, items, publishers}] top 50 by items, as_of: {run_id, seq, label_version}}; counted per run from the lines alone (live_gaps.journal_block); absent until a line carries a journal
run.degraded: list of strings, ["no landing"] when the run was started with ALLOW_NO_LANDING=1 and the cards could not be built; otherwise []
run.why: only when state is error before the first article (start-up failure, for example topic_landing could not build); no chain line exists then
run.file_sha: {path: sha256} for live_trace.py, live_gaps.py, structure_pack.py, pack_view.py, journal.py, mnds_codes.py, specs/mnds_name_to_code_v1.json, analyze2.py, facts_lib.py, scan_gate.py, extract.py, decider.py, expert1_runtime.py, this schema, the IPTC and WordNet files
run.model_sha: {path: sha256} for each model pickle the run loads

counts.backlog_ready: int, ready rows after the cursor not yet traced
counts.never_ready_since_start: int, found_at >= START and no ready_at yet (information, not part of the identity)
counts.rows_ready_since_start: int, read-only count of rows with ready_at >= START; identity the page checks: rows_ready_since_start = traced + skipped + backlog_ready
counts.rows_found_since_start: int, information only, count by found_at >= START
counts.ready_found_before_start: int, information only, rows found before START but ready at or after it

run.stages: {stage_name: {ran, empty, abstain, error, timeout, not_attached: counts, p50_ms, p90_ms}}
run.decider: {field: {outcome: count}} for story_type, topic, change, size, traits
run.gaps: [{code, count, rate, examples: [seq, ... up to 5]}] ranked by rate, no accuracy column
run.check_cmd: list of two read-only sqlite3 commands the owner can paste: the ready_at count (rows_ready_since_start) and the never_ready count

article_line.title: string, the headline as read (optional for old fixtures; the runner writes it; the page shows the URL if absent)
article_line.skip_reason: null or short string (too short, empty, error before any stage)

input.text_sha1: hex sha1 of the exact text string (also stored in a/<seq>.json)
input.pct_read_per_model: {model: percent of the text that model saw, where known}

article_line.decider: {field: {outcome, answer_or_proposed, marker, harvest}} from decider.py, or not_attached. v1 landing adds a sixth field topic_node (answer = the landing's level-1 code; confidence = p; threshold = the calibration line; marker BELOW_BAR from runs/pulse/field_table.json); absent when the landing has no calibration
article_line.journal: traced lines only, written by the runner (journal.py): {label_version: {iptc_release, cards, table}, ids: {topic: {best, l1, l2 (null for a level-1 landing), top3} or null, places: [ISO-2 country codes from place_linker top_countries], names: [strings, up to 20; names_id_space is "string" until Wikidata IDs exist (step 7)], names_id_space}, story_key: {title: sha1 or null, prefix: sha1 or null} (the keys actually used: title null when under 5 words or a column name, prefix null when the body is under 100 characters or is page boilerplate), dup: {kind: first | copy | republished | generic_title | no_key, of_seq: seq of the story's first item, or null for a root}, publishers: distinct sources carrying the story so far in this run (1 for a root; copies add, republished do not), permission: public-news}. Skipped lines carry none

stage.name: one of stage_names
stage.state: ran | empty | abstain | error | timeout | not_attached (timeout is reserved: the runner has no watchdog and never writes it; a stage over 2,000 ms gets slow: true and appears in run.slow_stages)
stage.out: compact output, at most about 600 characters when serialised (full output goes to a/<seq>.json stages_full)
stage.n: int count of items produced, or null
stage.provenance: Observed | Resolved | External | Inferred | Candidate (playbook 00 tags; the structure pack is Inferred)
stage.why: short reason for empty, abstain, error, timeout or not_attached (a not_attached stage names its source file and why it is not wired)

stage_names.name: windows
stage_names.note: Reader.read_detail: the v6b windows; says how much of the text the encoder saw

stage_names.name: facts
stage_names.note: Fact extractors, Binder, Validator: counts of stated, unbound, invalid items

stage_names.name: independent_counter
stage_names.note: ff[1] from facts_for; today analyze2 throws it away (L1 keeps it)

stage_names.name: tags_bundles
stage_names.note: Factuality tagger and Change lexicon via build_bundles

stage_names.name: area_function
stage_names.note: v6b topic head (49 labels, called Area) and story-type head (called Function)

stage_names.name: domain_rollup
stage_names.note: fixed 49-to-17 roll-up, specs/topic_to_iptc_v1.json; there is no separate Domain model

stage_names.name: capability_list
stage_names.note: match against the verb-object list (371 pairs); a list match, not a model

stage_names.name: topic_landing
stage_names.note: pack_view.Landing: the article (text[:2000]) and each sentence of 40+ characters land on the nearest IPTC Media Topic card (bge-small, 1,059 cards in qcode order). out (under 700 characters): best {qcode, layer, score, margin}, top3 [[qcode, score] x3], l1_code, l1_agree3 (1-3), vote [[l1_code, n_sentences] x up to 3] or [] (v1: the vote runs only when the 3 best cards disagree on the level-1 code, l1_agree3 under 3; otherwise []), voted (true when the vote ran), n_sent (sentences of 40+ characters, landed only when voted), agrees_rollup (code join; null if the roll-up did not run), decision (v0: EVIDENCE_ONLY; v1: ANSWER_L1 or ABSTAIN), and in v1 only: p (calibrated probability that l1_code is right, floor(1000 p) / 1000, the same integer the decision and the decider use) and damped (true when hub damping changed the best card). v1 = specs/landing_calibration_v1.json (hub-damped ranking, 9 features, vote gated on l1_agree3 < 3, as_of {run_id, seq, label_version}, the line where running accuracy held 0.80 on MN-DS T28); version string starts 'landing-v1' and ends 'calib <16 hex of that file>'; no file, or one fitted on other cards, gives v0 and run.json degraded says why. why in v1: 'p 0.310 below the line 0.780' on an abstain. n = 1 + n_sent. why 'no sentence of 40 characters' when the vote is empty. Full output in stages_full: article (5 nodes with path_codes), sentences (up to 12 nodes with n_sentences and 3 example sentences), and in v1 features (the 9 numbers the calibrator saw) and calibration {sha16, line_permille, as_of, stale}. Not attached when ALLOW_NO_LANDING=1 and the cards cannot be built; without that flag the run refuses to start. Provenance Inferred.

stage_names.name: structure_pack
stage_names.note: WordNet placement of the article's words on the IPTC tree; the topic guess moved to topic_landing. out: n_terms, n_placed, in_topic (counted against topic_landing.out.l1_code; null when the landing did not run), l1_code_used, hops, unplaced_share. provenance Inferred

stage_names.name: function_sentence
stage_names.note: NOT ATTACHED: the sentence-level Function head was never saved (runs/pulse/t210 does not exist)

stage_names.name: novelty
stage_names.note: NOT ATTACHED: no Novelty model exists (AUROC 0.51)

stage_names.name: factuality_story
stage_names.note: NOT ATTACHED: no whole-story Factuality head

gap_codes: TOPIC_DISAGREE (reference: landing IPTC level 1 code vs the legacy Domain roll-up; v1 traces: pack guess vs roll-up)
LANDING_SPLIT (article landing level 1 vs the sentence vote, vote of 3+ sentences)
LANDING_WEAK (v0: best cosine under 0.58; v1: decision ABSTAIN; v3: the re-ranker's decision is ABSTAIN)
RERANK_DISAGREE (v3, informational: the re-ranker's level-1 code differs from the landing's own)
SYNDICATED (journal dup.kind is copy or republished)
UNPLACED_HIGH (pack: share of nouns not placed)
anti_cheat: the runner selects only the allowlisted columns; category, region, country and story are never read
articles are read once, in ready_at order, with a cursor; every row since START gets a chain line (skipped rows too)
the prediction and START are on the ledger before the first article
the runner re-hashes its code and model files every 5 minutes and stops with state drift_stop if anything changed
the page offers: recompute the chain, recompute each text sha1, raw JSON link per article, a random-article button, no filters (seq order only)
